scope: Rendered same-machine browser acceptance for saved provider profiles and live OpenAI responses in the in-app browser and Microsoft Edge
provider_secret_handling: The configuration contained four api_key entries. No key value was read into the UI, copied into a prompt, included in navigation, or recorded in this evidence. Settings leaves the key field blank to reuse the saved backend credential.
connection: A fresh page showed Connect to local xMind. After connecting, the same-machine page displayed the active workspace, four saved provider choices and the active OpenAI model catalogue without asking for a server token or provider key.
negative_observation: The older open tab at 127.0.0.1:60415 reported that local xMind access was unavailable. It was not the connected view used for this acceptance.
limits: Local development runtime only; this is not hosted-release or installed-IDE acceptance.
The live responses verify text-only OpenAI requests and model/token/timing rendering, not streaming, tools, edits or complete provider compatibility.
